2608.02143.title: Beyond Solution-Centric Search: Adaptive Inquiry and Knowledge Revision for Autonomous ML Engineering
2608.02143.paper_summary: Long-horizon autonomous research tasks such as machine learning engineering require systems to make interdependent decisions under a limited budget. Existing LLM-based agents typically organize candidate-solution improvement through tree, graph, or chain structures, meaning that the search process determines how information is acquired and managed. We call this design solution-centric search and propose instead the information paradigm, in which an evolving information state represents the system's understanding of the task and guides solution improvement. We instantiate this paradigm in Iris, an inquiry-revision loop. For information acquisition, Iris generates local action plans from the current information state and uses epistemic actions to probe decision-critical unknowns without modifying the retained solution. For information management, Iris synthesizes observations across experiments into task knowledge composed of revisable claims with explicit scope and status. It updates this knowledge as new evidence arrives and constructs each decision context from raw evidence, structured summaries, or task knowledge at the required level of detail. On MLE-Bench, Iris attains a 64.9% any-medal rate under a 12-hour budget, the highest among compared systems. Across four tasks spanning harness engineering and model post-training, Iris also demonstrates cross-domain generalization.
2608.02143.paper_summary_zh: 長期自主研究任務，例如機器學習工程，要求系統在有限的預算下做出相互依賴的決策。現有的基於 LLM 的代理通常通過樹狀、圖形或鏈結構來組織候選解決方案的改進，這意味著搜索過程決定了信息的獲取和管理方式。我們稱這種設計為以解決方案為中心的搜索，而我們提出信息範式，其中不斷演變的信息狀態代表系統對任務的理解並指導解決方案的改進。我們在 Iris 中實現了這一範式，這是一個詢問-修訂循環。對於信息獲取，Iris 從當前信息狀態生成本地行動計劃，並使用認知行動來探測決策關鍵的未知數，而不修改保留的解決方案。對於信息管理，Iris 將實驗中的觀察綜合為任務知識，該知識由具有明確範圍和狀態的可修訂主張組成。它在新證據到達時更新這些知識，並根據原始證據、結構化摘要或所需詳細程度的任務知識構建每個決策上下文。在 MLE-Bench 上，Iris 在 12 小時預算內達到了 64.9% 的任何獎牌率，這是比較系統中最高的。在涵蓋工程和模型後訓練的四個任務中，Iris 也展示了跨領域的泛化能力。
